Executes arbitrary commands on the server hosting Spug under the application process identity: server compromise, access to credentials stored by the automation tool, pivot to supervised machines and lateral movement.
vulnerability_description.fr: Exécution de code à distance par injection de commandes OS (CWE-78). Exécute des commandes arbitraires sur le serveur hébergeant Spug sous l'identité du processus applicatif : compromission du serveur, accès aux credentials stockés par l'outil d'automatisation, pivot vers les machines supervisées et mouvement latéral.

vulnerability_description.en: Server-Side Request Forgery (CWE-918). Enables reading the cloud metadata service (potential IAM credential retrieval), mapping and accessing internal services and localhost, bypassing network segmentation and potentially leading to broader infrastructure compromise.
vulnerability_description.fr: Server-Side Request Forgery (CWE-918). Permet la lecture du service de métadonnées cloud (récupération potentielle de credentials IAM), la cartographie et l'accès aux services internes et localhost, le contournement de la segmentation réseau et potentiellement une compromission plus large de l'infrastructure.

vulnerability_description.en: Missing authorization (CWE-862) on REST API task endpoints. Compromises sandbox analysis confidentiality and integrity: disclosure of information on samples and ongoing investigations (including internal ones), potential sabotage of analyses by arbitrary deletion, disruption of incident response operations.
vulnerability_description.fr: Autorisation manquante (CWE-862) sur les endpoints REST API de tâches. Compromet la confidentialité et l'intégrité des analyses de la sandbox : divulgation d'informations sur les échantillons et investigations en cours (y compris internes), sabotage possible des analyses par suppression arbitraire, perturbation des opérations de réponse aux incidents.

vulnerability_description.en: Out-of-bounds read (CWE-125) in the ZstdDictDecompress constructor. Denial of service by JVM crash on Java applications performing dictionary decompression, with associated risk of out-of-bounds memory read.
vulnerability_description.fr: Lecture hors limites (CWE-125) dans le constructeur ZstdDictDecompress. Déni de service par crash de la JVM sur les applications Java effectuant de la décompression avec dictionnaire, avec risque associé de lecture de mémoire hors limites.

vulnerability_description.en: Out-of-bounds write (CWE-787) in Snappy.uncompress(ByteBuffer, ByteBuffer). Denial of service by JVM crash and potential memory corruption on Java services decompressing untrusted data with a caller-sized destination buffer.
vulnerability_description.fr: Écriture hors limites (CWE-787) dans Snappy.uncompress(ByteBuffer, ByteBuffer). Déni de service par crash de la JVM et corruption mémoire potentielle sur les services Java décompressant des données non fiables avec un tampon de destination dimensionné par l'appelant.

vulnerability_description.en: Stack buffer overflow (CWE-121) in SIP attribute formatting routines. Crash of the VoIP analysis tool or potentially arbitrary code execution on the analysis station, with a potentially privileged context (network capture, access to VoIP segments).
vulnerability_description.fr: Débordement de tampon de pile (CWE-121) dans les routines de formatage des attributs SIP. Crash de l'outil d'analyse VoIP voire exécution de code arbitraire sur la station d'analyse, avec un contexte potentiellement privilégié (capture réseau, accès aux segments VoIP).

fr: Débordement de tampon dans le tas

vulnerability_description.en: Heap buffer overflow (CWE-122) in worklist_load(). Memory corruption and crash of the client or server when loading a malicious savegame, with potential code execution on the user's workstation or server.
vulnerability_description.fr: Débordement de tampon de tas (CWE-122) dans worklist_load(). Corruption mémoire et crash du client ou du serveur lors du chargement d'un savegame malveillant, avec un potentiel d'exécution de code sur le poste de l'utilisateur ou du serveur.

vulnerability_description.en: Missing authorization (CWE-862) in plugin/Scheduler/sendEmail.json.php. Information leak (email addresses, private live titles, scheduled task details) and abuse of the instance's email sending service, potentially used for spam or phishing in the compromised domain's name.
vulnerability_description.fr: Absence d'autorisation (CWE-862) dans plugin/Scheduler/sendEmail.json.php. Fuite d'informations (adresses e-mail, titres de lives privés, détails des tâches planifiées) et abus du service d'envoi d'e-mails de l'instance, pouvant servir à du spam ou de l'hameçonnage au nom du domaine compromis.

list.affected_product: MemberPress Corporate Accounts (WordPress plugin) versions up to 1.5.39

vulnerability_description.en: Privilege escalation via mass assignment (CWE-269) in the add_sub_account_user function. Enables WordPress site takeover by creating or hijacking admin accounts, allowing code execution via theme/plugin editor, data exfiltration and backdoor deployment.
vulnerability_description.fr: Élévation de privilèges par affectation massive (CWE-269) dans la fonction add_sub_account_user. Permet la prise de contrôle du site WordPress par création ou détournement de comptes administrateur, permettant l'exécution de code via l'éditeur de thèmes/extensions, l'exfiltration de données et le déploiement de portes dérobées.

vulnerability_description.en: PHP object injection (CWE-502) leading to remote code execution. An attacker with at least a subscriber account (or unauthenticated if registration is open) can execute arbitrary code on the server, fully compromising the WordPress site and potentially the underlying infrastructure (webshell deployment, lateral movement, data exfiltration).
vulnerability_description.fr: Injection d'objets PHP (CWE-502) menant à une exécution de code à distance. Un attaquant disposant au minimum d'un compte subscriber (ou même non authentifié si l'inscription est ouverte) peut exécuter du code arbitraire sur le serveur, compromettant totalement le site WordPress et potentiellement l'infrastructure sous-jacente (déploiement de webshells, mouvement latéral, exfiltration de données).

vulnerability_description.en: Unauthenticated stored XSS via the youram_server AJAX action. Executes scripts in administrator sessions: potential WordPress site takeover, fraudulent account creation, content injection, redirection to malicious infrastructure and session data theft.
vulnerability_description.fr: XSS stockée non authentifiée via l'action AJAX youram_server. Exécute des scripts dans la session d'administrateurs : prise de contrôle potentielle du site WordPress, création de comptes frauduleux, injection de contenus, redirections vers des infrastructures malveillantes et vol de données de session.

vulnerability_description.en: Unauthenticated stored XSS via theme settings import (missing authorization and sanitisation). Executes arbitrary scripts in the browser of any site visitor, including administrators (session theft, admin account creation, malicious redirections), and destroys active theme settings causing defacement or site unavailability.
vulnerability_description.fr: XSS stockée non authentifiée via import des réglages du thème (absence d'autorisation et d'assainissement). Exécute des scripts arbitraires dans le navigateur de tout visiteur du site, y compris les administrateurs (vol de session, création de comptes admin, redirections malveillantes), et détruit les réglages du thème actif entraînant une défiguration ou une indisponibilité du site.

vulnerability_description.en: Unauthenticated stored XSS and configuration overwrite via REST API and AJAX actions without authorization control. Executes arbitrary scripts on every site page (visitor and administrator compromise, session cookie theft, redirections) and overwrites plugin configuration potentially defacing the site or hijacking its features.
vulnerability_description.fr: XSS stockée non authentifiée et écrasement de configuration via actions REST API et AJAX sans contrôle d'autorisation. Exécute des scripts arbitraires sur chaque page du site (compromission des visiteurs et des administrateurs, vol de cookies de session, redirections), et écrase la configuration du plugin pouvant défigurer le site ou détourner ses fonctionnalités.

vulnerability_description.en: Stored XSS (CWE-79) via authorization bypass on a REST route. A subscriber can execute arbitrary JavaScript in an administrator's browser, enabling session hijacking, backdoor account creation, malicious plugin installation and full site compromise.
vulnerability_description.fr: XSS stockée (CWE-79) via contournement d'autorisation sur une route REST. Un abonné peut faire exécuter du JavaScript arbitraire dans le navigateur d'un administrateur, permettant le détournement de session, la création de comptes backdoor, l'installation de plugins malveillants et une compromission complète du site.

vulnerability_description.en: Privilege escalation (CWE-269) via missing capability check and nonce verification. A low-privilege user can obtain administrator role on a multisite, leading to full takeover of the installation (network sites, content, plugins, users).
vulnerability_description.fr: Élévation de privilèges (CWE-269) par absence de vérification de capacité et de nonce. Un utilisateur à faibles privilèges peut obtenir le rôle administrateur sur un multisite, conduisant à une prise de contrôle complète de l'installation (sites du réseau, contenus, plugins, utilisateurs).

vulnerability_description.en: Unauthenticated PHP object injection (CWE-502) via the embedded wpsc-membership-pro paypal.php add-on. An unauthenticated attacker can inject arbitrary PHP objects; depending on available gadget chains, this may lead to remote code execution, data manipulation or other cascading impacts.
vulnerability_description.fr: Injection d'objets PHP non authentifiée (CWE-502) via l'add-on embarqué wpsc-membership-pro paypal.php. Un attaquant non authentifié peut injecter des objets PHP arbitraires ; selon les gadget chains disponibles sur le site, cela peut mener à l'exécution de code à distance, à la manipulation de données ou à d'autres impacts en cascade.

vulnerability_description.en: Unauthenticated SQL injection (CWE-89). An unauthenticated attacker can read, and potentially modify, the WordPress database content: exfiltration of credentials (hashes), private content, admin account creation or, depending on database configuration, command execution via the SQL stack (CAPEC-108/CAPEC-470).
vulnerability_description.fr: Injection SQL non authentifiée (CWE-89). Un attaquant non authentifié peut lire, et potentiellement modifier, le contenu de la base de données WordPress : exfiltration d'identifiants (hachages), de contenus privés, création de comptes administrateur ou, selon la configuration de la base, exécution de commandes via la pile SQL (CAPEC-108/CAPEC-470).

vulnerability_description.en: Unauthenticated stored XSS and widget manipulation via missing authorization control (CWE-79). Executes scripts in visitors' browsers: session and cookie theft, malicious redirections, data skimming, admin account creation via privileged session hijacking, site defacement.
vulnerability_description.fr: XSS stockée non authentifiée et manipulation de widgets via absence de contrôle d'autorisation (CWE-79). Exécute des scripts dans les navigateurs des visiteurs : vol de sessions et de cookies, redirections malveillantes, skimming de données, création de comptes administrateur via le détournement de sessions privilégiées, défiguration du site.

vulnerability_description.en: Unauthenticated path traversal in page template resolution leading to remote code execution. Exploited within 5 hours of disclosure, allowing arbitrary code execution on the web server, complete WordPress hosting compromise, webshell installation and potential pivot to the internal network. Corrected in 7.1.2, 7.0.6, 6.9.9, 6.8.10.
vulnerability_description.fr: Traversée de chemin non authentifiée dans la résolution de template de page menant à une exécution de code à distance. Exploitée dans les 5 heures suivant la divulgation, permettant l'exécution de code arbitraire sur le serveur web, la compromission complète de l'hébergement WordPress, l'installation de webshells et un pivot potentiel vers le réseau interne. Corrigée en 7.1.2, 7.0.6, 6.9.9, 6.8.10.

list.affected_product: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, SmartEvent (R82.20, R82.10, R82, R81.20, R81.10, R81, R80.x)

vulnerability_description.en: Unauthenticated path traversal and file upload in the management server web service allowing an attacker to upload and execute scripts, leading to arbitrary code execution and Java class loading. Compromise of the centralised security management infrastructure enables policy modification, protection disabling, log access and lateral propagation across the managed network. Actively exploited; CISA KEV addition.
vulnerability_description.fr: Traversée de chemin et upload de fichier non authentifiés dans le service web du serveur de management permettant à un attaquant de téléverser et d'exécuter des scripts, menant à une exécution de code arbitraire et au chargement de classes Java. La compromission de l'infrastructure de management de sécurité centralisée permet la modification des politiques, la désactivation des protections, l'accès aux journaux et une propagation latérale à travers le réseau géré. Activement exploitée ; ajout au CISA KEV.

fr: Débordement de tampon dans le tas

vulnerability_description.en: Heap-based buffer overflow leading to unauthenticated remote code execution on BIG-IP APM systems configured with an APM access policy and OAuth profile. Complete compromise of the authentication gateway, with risk of access to applications, web portals, VPN services and protected resources. Internet-exposed deployments are most critical. Actively exploited; CISA KEV addition with hotfixes available.
vulnerability_description.fr: Débordement de tampon dans le tas menant à une exécution de code à distance non authentifiée sur les systèmes BIG-IP APM configurés avec une politique d'accès APM et un profil OAuth. Compromission complète de la passerelle d'authentification, avec risque d'accès aux applications, portails web, services VPN et ressources protégées. Les déploiements exposés sur Internet sont les plus critiques. Activement exploitée ; ajout au CISA KEV avec hotfixs disponibles.

vulnerability_description.en: Unauthenticated remote attacker can access privileged internal functions and affect the VCO host, compromising the SD-WAN orchestration console: network policy modification, traffic redirection or interception, access to orchestration secrets and pivot to managed Edge devices. Webshell and backdoor daemon installation with systemd persistence observed. Actively exploited; CISA KEV addition.
vulnerability_description.fr: Un attaquant distant non authentifié peut accéder à des fonctions internes privilégiées et affecter l'hôte VCO, compromettant la console d'orchestration SD-WAN : modification des politiques réseau, redirection ou interception du trafic, accès aux secrets d'orchestration et pivot vers les équipements Edge gérés. Installation de webshells et de démons backdoor avec persistance systemd observée. Activement exploitée ; ajout au CISA KEV.

list.affected_product: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager, Universal Gateway

vulnerability_description.en: Path traversal allowing unrestricted file upload and remote code execution on WSO2 servers, compromising API services, unauthorised access to data and integrations, and pivot to connected enterprise systems. Actively exploited; CISA KEV addition with FCEB remediation deadline of 27 September 2026.
vulnerability_description.fr: Traversée de chemin permettant un upload de fichier non restreint et une exécution de code à distance sur les serveurs WSO2, compromettant les services d'API, l'accès non autorisé aux données et aux intégrations, et un pivot vers les systèmes d'entreprise connectés. Activement exploitée ; ajout au CISA KEV avec échéance de remédiation FCEB au 27 septembre 2026.

list.affected_product: Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, Magento Open Source

vulnerability_description.en: Incorrect authorization allowing high-privilege access to sensitive resources, enabling customer session takeover, account takeover and access to private data (personal information, order histories) on e-commerce platforms. Actively exploited; CISA KEV addition with FCEB remediation deadline of 27 September 2026.
vulnerability_description.fr: Autorisation incorrecte permettant un accès élevé à des ressources sensibles, permettant la bascule de sessions clients, la prise de contrôle de comptes et l'accès à des données privées (informations personnelles, historiques de commandes) sur les plateformes e-commerce. Activement exploitée ; ajout au CISA KEV avec échéance de remédiation FCEB au 27 septembre 2026.

vulnerability_description.en: Code injection allowing authenticated remote code execution via deserialisation, enabling webshell deployment in memory and potential pre-authentication compromise when chained with an authentication bypass. Actively exploited; CISA KEV addition.
vulnerability_description.fr: Injection de code permettant une exécution de code à distance authentifiée via désérialisation, permettant le déploiement de webshells en mémoire et une compromission potentielle pré-authentification lorsqu'elle est chaînée avec un contournement d'authentification. Activement exploitée ; ajout au CISA KEV.

fr: Application incorrecte du flux de travail comportemental

vulnerability_description.en: SSH state machine flaw allowing authentication bypass, enabling unauthenticated access to the SSH command phase. When chained with CVE-2026-86060, allows full administrative takeover of the router without password or SSH key, with persistent account creation and configuration exfiltration. Actively exploited; CISA KEV addition.
vulnerability_description.fr: Défaut de machine à états SSH permettant de contourner l'authentification, donnant un accès non authentifié à la phase de commande SSH. Lorsqu'elle est chaînée avec CVE-2026-86060, permet une prise de contrôle administrative complète du routeur sans mot de passe ni clé SSH, avec création de comptes persistants et exfiltration de la configuration. Activement exploitée ; ajout au CISA KEV.

vulnerability_description.en: Pre-authentication SQL injection via escape bypass in preg_replace(), allowing unauthenticated access to the Roundcube database, potential exposure of mail account credentials, stored messages, address books and account data. Actively exploited.
vulnerability_description.fr: Injection SQL pré-authentification via contournement d'échappement dans preg_replace(), permettant un accès non authentifié à la base de données Roundcube, l'exposition potentielle des identifiants de comptes mail, des messages stockés, des carnets d'adresses et des données de comptes. Activement exploitée.

vulnerability_description.en: Authentication bypass via insufficient authentication control on an API endpoint, allowing unauthenticated takeover of the ISE administration interface: access to network authentication and authorisation policies, configuration modification, persistent access creation and potential extension to the entire network access control (NAC). Actively exploited.
vulnerability_description.fr: Contournement d'authentification via contrôle d'authentification insuffisant sur un endpoint API, permettant une prise de contrôle non authentifiée de l'interface d'administration ISE : accès aux politiques d'authentification et d'autorisation réseau, modification de la configuration, création d'accès persistants et extension potentielle à l'ensemble du contrôle d'accès réseau (NAC). Activement exploitée.

list.affected_product: Check Point Security Management and Log Server (R80 to R82)

vulnerability_description.en: Stack overflow in the login process allowing remote code execution as root on management servers, enabling total takeover of the security infrastructure, policy modification, protection disabling and compromise of the entire managed estate.
vulnerability_description.fr: Débordement de pile dans le processus de login permettant l'exécution de code à distance en root sur les serveurs de management, permettant la prise de contrôle totale de l'infrastructure de sécurité, la modification des politiques, la désactivation des protections et la compromission de l'ensemble du parc géré.

fr: Exécution de code à distance pré-authentifiée

vulnerability_description.en: Pre-authenticated remote code execution in Oracle PeopleSoft, exploited by ShinyHunters to breach the FBI (FBIjobs.gov, Oracle PeopleSoft, AWS GovCloud), exfiltrating 2-3 TB of agent and applicant data, defacing public sites and enabling extortion. Actively exploited.
vulnerability_description.fr: Exécution de code à distance pré-authentifiée dans Oracle PeopleSoft, exploitée par ShinyHunters pour violer le FBI (FBIjobs.gov, Oracle PeopleSoft, AWS GovCloud), exfiltrant 2 à 3 To de données d'agents et de candidats, défigurant des sites publics et permettant l'extorsion. Activement exploitée.

list.affected_product: Next.js 16.2.0 to 16.3.5 (Node.js runtime) and Satori library

vulnerability_description.en: Unescaped SVG injection in ImageResponse leading to server-side code execution on the Node.js server hosting the Next.js application, compromising the application and potentially the data and secrets it handles. Corrected in Next.js 16.3.6 and Satori 0.33.5.
vulnerability_description.fr: Injection SVG non échappée dans ImageResponse menant à une exécution de code côté serveur sur le serveur Node.js hébergeant l'application Next.js, compromettant l'application et potentiellement les données et secrets qu'elle manipule. Corrigée en Next.js 16.3.6 et Satori 0.33.5.

list.affected_product: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS GlobalProtect VPN

vulnerability_description.en: Authentication bypass allowing unauthorised network and data access, theft of personal data of approximately 246,000 individuals, compromise of maintenance accounts and massive access to sensitive files. Actively exploited; CISA KEV addition.
vulnerability_description.fr: Contournement d'authentification permettant un accès non autorisé au réseau et aux données, le vol de données personnelles d'environ 246 000 personnes, la compromission de comptes de maintenance et un accès massif à des fichiers sensibles. Activement exploitée ; ajout au CISA KEV.

list.affected_product: Veeam Agent for Microsoft Windows up to 13.0.1.2067

vulnerability_description.en: Local privilege escalation allowing a low-privileged local user to obtain NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM privileges on a Windows endpoint, enabling complete machine compromise. Public PoC available; actively exploited.
vulnerability_description.fr: Élévation de privilèges locale permettant à un utilisateur local à faibles privilèges d'obtenir les privilèges NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM sur un endpoint Windows, permettant une compromission complète de la machine. PoC public disponible ; activement exploitée.

fr: Débordement de tampon basé sur la pile

vulnerability_description.en: Stack-based buffer overflow allowing arbitrary OS command execution on the switch by an unauthenticated LAN attacker, complete device compromise, exfiltration of configurations, root credential hashes and network information. Risk of pivot to other network segments and reuse of exfiltrated credentials. Actively exploited; CISA KEV addition with FCEB remediation deadline of 24 September 2026.
vulnerability_description.fr: Débordement de tampon basé sur la pile permettant l'exécution de commandes OS arbitraires sur le switch par un attaquant LAN non authentifié, compromission complète de l'équipement, exfiltration de configurations, de hashes de credentials root et d'informations réseau. Risque de pivot vers d'autres segments réseau et de réutilisation des credentials exfiltrés. Activement exploitée ; ajout au CISA KEV avec échéance de remédiation FCEB au 24 septembre 2026.

vulnerability_description.en: Double free during regular expression parsing leading to arbitrary code execution on the GitLab server, compromising repositories, CI/CD secrets and access tokens, with risk of lateral movement to build and deployment chains.
vulnerability_description.fr: Double free lors du parsing d'expressions régulières menant à une exécution de code arbitraire sur le serveur GitLab, compromettant les dépôts, les secrets CI/CD et les jetons d'accès, avec risque de mouvement latéral vers les chaînes de build et de déploiement.

vulnerability_description.en: Integer overflow or wraparound leading to arbitrary code execution on the GitLab server with service privileges, compromising all repositories, CI/CD secrets, access tokens and hosted data. High risk of lateral movement to build and production environments.
vulnerability_description.fr: Débordement d'entier ou wraparound menant à une exécution de code arbitraire sur le serveur GitLab avec les privilèges du service, compromettant l'ensemble des dépôts, secrets CI/CD, jetons d'accès et données hébergées. Risque élevé de mouvement latéral vers les environnements de build et de production.

list.affected_product: ServiceNow AI Platform (hosted and self-hosted instances)

vulnerability_description.en: Missing authorization control allowing unauthenticated disclosure of sensitive instance data, leakage of business and customer information, privilege escalation and compliance risk (GDPR, personal data).
vulnerability_description.fr: Contrôle d'autorisation manquant permettant la divulgation non authentifiée de données d'instance, la fuite d'informations sensibles métier et clients, l'élévation de privilèges et un risque de conformité (RGPD, données personnelles).

vulnerability_description.en: Type confusion allowing arbitrary code execution under the postgres system user, PostgreSQL backend crash, and compromise of the database instance and hosted data. Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL and Aurora PostgreSQL are not impacted (they ship only version 1.1.1).
vulnerability_description.fr: Confusion de type permettant l'exécution de code arbitraire sous l'utilisateur système postgres, le crash du backend PostgreSQL et la compromission de l'instance de base de données et des données hébergées. Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL et Aurora PostgreSQL ne sont pas impactés (ils ne livrent que la version 1.1.1).

vulnerability_description.en: Dangerous file upload leading to remote code execution with web process privileges, complete compromise of the application and hosting server. Corrected in 7.0.2.
vulnerability_description.fr: Upload de fichier dangereux menant à une exécution de code à distance avec les privilèges du processus web, compromission complète de l'application et du serveur hébergeant. Corrigée en 7.0.2.

vulnerability_description.en: Unauthenticated OS command injection leading to remote code execution with web process privileges, complete compromise of the MediaWiki server. Corrected in ExternalData 3.7.
vulnerability_description.fr: Injection de commandes OS non authentifiée menant à une exécution de code à distance avec les privilèges du processus web, compromission totale du serveur MediaWiki. Corrigée dans ExternalData 3.7.

vulnerability_description.en: Authentication bypass via spoofing, allowing bypass of IP-based access controls, unauthorised access to protected interfaces and network identity spoofing. Corrected in 3.3.5.
vulnerability_description.fr: Contournement d'authentification par usurpation, permettant de contourner les contrôles d'accès basés sur l'IP, l'accès non autorisé aux interfaces protégées et l'usurpation d'identité réseau. Corrigée en 3.3.5.

vulnerability_description.en: Dangerous file upload leading to remote code execution with web server user privileges, complete compromise of the GestSup instance. Corrected in 3.2.61.
vulnerability_description.fr: Upload de fichier dangereux menant à une exécution de code à distance avec les privilèges de l'utilisateur du serveur web, compromission complète de l'instance GestSup. Corrigée en 3.2.61.

vulnerability_description.en: Incorrect authentication allowing takeover of any existing account, including agents and administrators, without knowing the local password. Corrected in 7.1.2.
vulnerability_description.fr: Authentification incorrecte permettant la prise de contrôle de tout compte existant, y compris agents et administrateurs, sans connaître le mot de passe local. Corrigée en 7.1.2.

vulnerability_description.en: Authentication bypass via hardcoded default credentials, allowing takeover of arbitrary accounts and unauthorised access to application features and user data.
vulnerability_description.fr: Contournement d'authentification via des identifiants par défaut codés en dur, permettant la prise de contrôle de comptes arbitraires et l'accès non autorisé aux fonctionnalités applicatives et aux données utilisateurs.

vulnerability_description.en: Authentication bypass allowing account takeover, unauthorised access to data and features, and potential escalation to privileged accounts. Actively exploited.
vulnerability_description.fr: Contournement d'authentification permettant la prise de contrôle de comptes, l'accès non autorisé aux données et fonctionnalités, et une escalade potentielle vers des comptes à privilèges. Activement exploitée.

vulnerability_description.en: Unauthenticated SQL injection allowing disclosure, modification or deletion of database data, potentially complete compromise of the WordPress site. Corrected in versions > 3.1.7.
vulnerability_description.fr: Injection SQL non authentifiée permettant la divulgation, la modification ou la suppression de données de la base de données, potentiellement la compromission totale du site WordPress. Corrigée dans les versions > 3.1.7.

vulnerability_description.en: Improper isolation or compartmentalisation exposing device and user profile data, unauthorised control of connected devices (start/stop), risk of physical harm (burns) from involuntary activation.
vulnerability_description.fr: Isolation ou compartimentation inappropriée exposant les données d'appareils et de profils utilisateurs, contrôle non autorisé d'appareils connectés (démarrage/arrêt), risque de dommages physiques (brûlures) liés à l'activation involontaire.

list.affected_product: Adobe Connect 12.11 and earlier; Adobe Connect Android app 4.4 and earlier

vulnerability_description.en: SQL injection and other critical weaknesses allowing remote code execution, privilege escalation and potential compromise of the Adobe Connect server and hosted data. Corrected in Adobe Connect 12.12 and Android app 4.5.
vulnerability_description.fr: Injection SQL et autres faiblesses critiques permettant l'exécution de code à distance, l'escalade de privilèges et la compromission potentielle du serveur Adobe Connect et des données hébergées. Corrigée dans Adobe Connect 12.12 et l'application Android 4.5.

list.affected_product: Adobe Experience Manager Forms on JEE — AEM 6.5 LTS Forms SP2 and earlier; AEM 6.5 Forms 6.5.25 and earlier

vulnerability_description.en: Incorrect authorization and other critical weaknesses allowing unauthenticated remote code execution, privilege escalation and bypass of security controls on exposed AEM Forms instances. Corrected in AEM 6.5 LTS Forms SP3 and AEM 6.5 Forms hotfix.
vulnerability_description.fr: Autorisation incorrecte et autres faiblesses critiques permettant une exécution de code à distance non authentifiée, une escalade de privilèges et un contournement des contrôles de sécurité sur les instances AEM Forms exposées. Corrigée dans AEM 6.5 LTS Forms SP3 et le hotfix AEM 6.5 Forms.

vulnerability_description.en: Use after free leading to memory corruption, application crash and potential arbitrary code execution with IBM Concert service privileges.
vulnerability_description.fr: Use after free menant à une corruption mémoire, un crash applicatif et une exécution potentielle de code arbitraire avec les privilèges du service IBM Concert.

vulnerability_description.en: Buffer copy without checking size of input leading to arbitrary code execution on the host system with application privileges, memory corruption and application crash.
vulnerability_description.fr: Copie de tampon sans vérification de la taille d'entrée menant à une exécution de code arbitraire sur le système hôte avec les privilèges de l'application, corruption mémoire et crash applicatif.

vulnerability_description.en: OS command injection allowing unauthenticated remote code execution on the server hosting IBM Concert, complete host compromise and lateral movement risk.
vulnerability_description.fr: Injection de commandes OS permettant une exécution de code à distance non authentifiée sur le serveur hébergeant IBM Concert, compromission complète de l'hôte et risque de mouvement latéral.

vulnerability_description.en: Improper certificate validation with silent verify_none fallback during JWKS retrieval, allowing identity spoofing and authentication with forged JWTs, unauthorised access to message queues and data transiting the broker.
vulnerability_description.fr: Validation de certificat incorrecte avec fallback silencieux verify_none lors de la récupération JWKS, permettant l'usurpation d'identité et l'authentification avec des JWT forgés, l'accès non autorisé aux files de messages et aux données transitant par le broker.

vulnerability_description.en: Improper certificate validation allowing complete bypass of mutual TLS authentication on the RabbitMQ broker: unauthenticated access to queues, messages and administration interfaces exposed via TLS, with potentially critical impact on confidentiality and integrity of messaging flows.
vulnerability_description.fr: Validation de certificat incorrecte permettant un contournement complet de l'authentification mutuelle TLS sur le broker RabbitMQ : accès non authentifié aux files, aux messages et aux interfaces d'administration exposées via TLS, avec un impact potentiellement critique sur la confidentialité et l'intégrité des flux de messagerie.

list.affected_product: WP Toolkit for cPanel 6.11.2-10794 and earlier

vulnerability_description.en: Argument injection allowing any account holder on a shared server to read arbitrary files and execute code in the context of other customer accounts, leading to cross-account hosting compromise, data leakage and WordPress database alteration. Corrected in 6.11.3.
vulnerability_description.fr: Injection d'arguments permettant à tout titulaire de compte sur un serveur mutualisé de lire des fichiers arbitraires et d'exécuter du code dans le contexte d'autres comptes clients, entraînant une compromission croisée des hébergements, une fuite de données et une altération des bases de données WordPress. Corrigée en 6.11.3.

list.affected_product: cPanel & WHM version 120 and above (CalDAV/CardDAV); WP Squared

vulnerability_description.en: Execution with unnecessary privileges allowing complete compromise of the hosting server: root code execution, access to all customer accounts, data and configurations, with risk of chain compromise of all hosted sites. Corrected in 11.134.0.57, 11.136.0.41, 11.138.0.8.
vulnerability_description.fr: Exécution avec des privilèges superflus permettant la compromission complète du serveur d'hébergement : exécution de code en root, accès à l'ensemble des comptes clients, des données et des configurations, avec un risque de compromission en chaîne de tous les sites hébergés. Corrigée en 11.134.0.57, 11.136.0.41, 11.138.0.8.

list.affected_product: IBM Financial Transaction Manager (FTM) for RedHat OpenShift

vulnerability_description.en: Path traversal via incorrect symbolic link validation allowing disclosure of sensitive information (configuration files, secrets, business data) that could facilitate lateral movement or deeper compromise of the financial transaction platform.
vulnerability_description.fr: Traversée de chemin via validation incorrecte des liens symboliques permettant la divulgation d'informations sensibles (fichiers de configuration, secrets, données métier) pouvant faciliter des mouvements latéraux ou une compromission plus profonde de la plateforme de transactions financières.

list.affected_product: IBM Financial Transaction Manager (FTM) for RedHat OpenShift

vulnerability_description.en: Deserialization of untrusted data leading to arbitrary remote code execution on the FTM server, potentially complete compromise of the financial transaction platform, data theft or service interruption.
vulnerability_description.fr: Désérialisation de données non fiables menant à une exécution de code arbitraire à distance sur le serveur FTM, pouvant conduire à une compromission totale de la plateforme de transactions financières, à un vol de données ou à une interruption de service.

list.affected_product: IBM Financial Transaction Manager (FTM) for RedHat OpenShift

vulnerability_description.en: Code injection via improper neutralisation of user input in the Function constructor, leading to arbitrary remote code execution on the FTM server, compromising confidentiality, integrity and availability of the financial transaction platform.
vulnerability_description.fr: Injection de code via neutralisation incorrecte d'entrées utilisateur dans le constructeur Function, menant à une exécution de code arbitraire à distance sur le serveur FTM, compromettant la confidentialité, l'intégrité et la disponibilité de la plateforme de transactions financières.

list.affected_product: IBM Financial Transaction Manager (FTM) for Red Hat OpenShift

vulnerability_description.en: Improper privilege management leading to privilege escalation and complete compromise of the FTM application and underlying OpenShift cluster, with high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability and a security scope change.
vulnerability_description.fr: Gestion incorrecte des privilèges menant à une élévation de privilèges et à la compromission complète de l'application FTM et du cluster OpenShift sous-jacent, avec un impact élevé sur la confidentialité, l'intégrité et la disponibilité et un changement de périmètre de sécurité.

list.affected_product: IBM Financial Transaction Manager (FTM) for Red Hat OpenShift

fr: Absence d'authentification pour une fonction critique

vulnerability_description.en: Missing authentication for a critical function allowing unauthorised actions on critical FTM functions, with high impact on confidentiality and integrity of transactional data, without direct impact on availability.
vulnerability_description.fr: Absence d'authentification pour une fonction critique permettant l'exécution d'actions non autorisées sur des fonctions critiques de FTM, avec un impact élevé sur la confidentialité et l'intégrité des données transactionnelles, sans impact direct sur la disponibilité.

vulnerability_description.en: OS command injection via AWS Bedrock credential injection, allowing arbitrary code execution as root on the MaxKB host, potential compromise of AWS credentials and pivot to the cloud environment. Corrected in 2.10.5-lts.
vulnerability_description.fr: Injection de commandes OS via injection d'identifiants AWS Bedrock, permettant l'exécution de code arbitraire en tant que root sur l'hôte hébergeant MaxKB, la compromission potentielle des identifiants AWS et un pivot vers l'environnement cloud. Corrigée en 2.10.5-lts.

vulnerability_description.en: Command execution via prompt injection and exposure of a dangerous shell tool, allowing arbitrary code execution on the host, sandbox escape and complete compromise of the MaxKB instance. Corrected in 2.10.5-lts.
vulnerability_description.fr: Exécution de commandes via injection de prompt et exposition d'un outil shell dangereux, permettant l'exécution de code arbitraire sur l'hôte, l'évasion de bac à sable et la compromission complète de l'instance MaxKB. Corrigée en 2.10.5-lts.

vulnerability_description.en: HAProxy configuration injection by an authenticated user, potentially leading to load balancer compromise, traffic manipulation, arbitrary directive execution and privilege escalation on the amphora. Corrected in 18.0.1 (OSSA-2026-039).
vulnerability_description.fr: Injection de configuration HAProxy par un utilisateur authentifié, pouvant conduire à la compromission du load balancer, à la manipulation du trafic, à l'exécution de directives arbitraires et à l'élévation de privilèges sur l'amphora. narrative.en:
- **Healthcare & Life Sciences (dominant target of the week):** McKesson (284M patient records claimed by ShinyHunters, ~1 TB exfiltrated from Snowflake and Salesforce environments), Aesto Health (9.54M records, AWS infrastructure compromise affecting 30 client organisations), Baylor Genetics (2.81M records including genetic testing data), DaVita (2.4M dialysis patients, USD 15M lawsuit settlement), Hôpital Privé de la Loire in Saint-Étienne (727,113 individuals, EUR 500,000 CNIL fine for GDPR Art. 32/34 failures), Novocure (1,450 cancer patients, ShinyHunters extortion), Nutex Health (100,000 records, The Gentlemen ransomware), Cornerstone Behavioral Healthcare (14,830 patients, substance-use treatment data), LHC Group/Optum (16,885 patients via vishing), Manning Regional Healthcare Center (746 patients), MedEvolve (820 GB claimed by Settra), Blossom Health (29,600 clients including psychotherapy data) and Cardiology Associates of Port Huron (150,380 records, 124,893 unique SSNs, Times Up ransomware).
- **Government & Defense:** Berlin Senate (1.44M files / 5.79 TB exfiltrated by Rhysida, including clear-text credentials and KRITIS water-supply vulnerability analyses), US ATF (6.3 GB of criminal case files, Cellebrite dumps and wiretap material leaked by Qilin), Latvian CSDD (1.2M identity and vehicle records), City of Roanoke Virginia (SSNs, passport numbers), North Dakota Supreme Court (third-party breach affecting dozens of states), Natural Resources Wales (sensitive HR equality-monitoring data), Myanmar RTAD (1.08 GB of vehicle and insurance databases), DGFiP/impots.gouv.fr in France (taxpayer data, suspect "ChatNoir" of ZeroBytes indicted), French Ministère de la Transition écologique, and the Israeli government "network 26" targeted by a Hebrew-language ClickFix campaign.
- **Technology & Telecom / Software Supply Chain:** IDScan.net (153M US and Canadian driver's licence scans with facial biometrics, FBI investigation, class actions), Coder registry compromise pushing malicious Terraform modules (cloud API keys, CI/CD credentials and SSH keys exposed), Dropbox (5,000 accounts compromised via a legacy Lenovo ID authentication integration with a flawed email verification process), Accenture (source code, SSH keys and Azure credentials claimed), JetBrains Cadence/TeamCity (CVE-2026-63077, AWS IAM credential theft), and the DEV#POPPER campaign abusing fake job interviews and a typosquatted npm package impersonating Babel with Ethereum smart-contract C2 resolution.
- **Business Services & Legal:** Questel (1.23M unique email addresses), Thomson Reuters C-Track (SSNs, medical data and sealed court records across multiple US state court systems), Greenberg Traurig and a dozen US law firms claimed by LeakedData, HumanEdge staffing (2,222 individuals), Central National Gottesman (1,433 records), Brown Jake & McDaniel CPA firm (1,866 records), and an unprecedented cyberattack against the French notarial profession.
- **Retail, Consumer & Hospitality:** Trezor via logistics partner ShipMonk (80,000 hardware-wallet customers, expanded from 13,689, exploited through a Metabase CVE-2026-72898 SQL injection), Manchester Airports Group (8.73M travellers, FulcrumSec claim of 86 GB), See's Candies (Qilin ransomware), Charm Japan (390,000 records, 239 unauthorised logins), Hasbro (employee SSNs), Valve/Steam (10,876 repositories of game builds leaked), Micromania France (third-party parcel-tracking provider), Fishbrain (password hashes), and the MAMAMOO JAPAN fanclub "MOOMOO JAPAN" (member emails and passwords via a supplier server breach).
- **Finance & Crypto:** Hyperliquid (USD 30M in Bitcoin moved by North Korea-linked actors), Ledger (USD 500M class action over prior data breaches), Citizens Pay/CTZPay Myanmar (30 GB claimed by Dysphor1a), and the Tectonic protocol on Cronos blockchain (USD 74M stolen via price manipulation, chain halted and restarted).
- **Media & Entertainment:** Tving South Korea (40M accounts plus 361 development projects including source code and recommendation algorithms), X/Twitter users (5M email addresses dumped, credential-stuffing wave after X Money launch), and the vx-underground malware library taken offline by DDoS.
- **Education & Research:** Uak University (Qilin claim), METR AI evaluator (API key theft with USD 600,000 of AI credits consumed over three weeks, plus infrastructure probing), and the French Éducation nationale (paper-based school start in Nantes and Toulouse academies).
- **Industry, Real Estate & Critical Infrastructure:** AGUNSA Chile (Qilin, employee drug-test data), Ando Hazama Japan (5,000 business contacts), Mitsui Fudosan (55,000 records), Castle Group Florida (47 residents), REXT Holdings (RansomHouse), Gwangmyeong Industry South Korea (Blacklocks), and UK industrial infrastructure exposure (564 internet-reachable hosts, 26 exposed controllers, 383 building-automation hosts) following an Iran-linked attack on a British energy producer.

- **Healthcare & Life Sciences (dominant target):** The sector absorbed the largest share of confirmed breaches this week. AdaptHealth (4.1M patients, medical equipment and home care data), McKesson (6.4M records claimed by ShinyHunters), Veradigm (3.5M patients, SSNs, Gentlemen gang), Baxter International (7.1M Salesforce records), American Vision Partners (2.2M), LHC Group/Optum (162,578 patients with Medicare/Medicaid data), Novo Nordisk (1TB of experimental drug data and API tokens after GitHub token theft), MyDr in Poland (18.8M people, PESEL identifiers, 12,000+ medical facilities), Gangnam Unni in South Korea (219,665 users including 48,000 Japanese, consultation photos and treatment details), and Interim HealthCare (1.5TB claimed by Genesis and Anubis). The sector's combination of sensitive PHI, HIPAA/GDPR exposure and operational dependence on EHR platforms makes it the highest-value ransomware and extortion target.

- **Government & Defense:** Berlin's Landesnetz was breached by Rhysida with 5.79TB leaked including classified information handling records and water supply vulnerability analyses; the Florida DMV DAVID database was accessed via a stolen police account (200,000+ records claimed by ShinyHunters); the French DGFiP suffered a mass tax data theft (678,000 individuals) triggering a CNIL investigation; Vietnam's APIS passenger database exposed 220.8M travel records on Viettel infrastructure; Japan's Digital Agency reported 246,000 potentially exposed records; Indonesia's DUKCAPIL and BGN nutrition agency databases were listed for sale; and the Aveyron department in France lost 20,000 job-seeker records.

- **Technology & Telecom:** Hugging Face confirmed cloud credentials and Spaces secrets exposure following the OpenAI agent incident; Trezor customers were targeted via ShipMonk (81,000) and Brevo (347,000) supply-chain compromises; Salt Mobile in Switzerland disclosed a customer data theft; i2k2 Networks (India) was claimed by Vexy; and Anthropic reported that attackers abused Claude to extract secrets from 1.8 million Android applications, exposing API keys and cloud backends.

- **Finance:** Revolut confirmed a major KYC data breach after falling for fake government requests, exposing passport copies, selfies, IBANs and complete Bitcoin transaction histories; Toss Payments and Coem Payments in South Korea leaked cardholder names, card numbers and partial PINs; Lincoln National Life Insurance exposed SSNs and medical information; and India LEI (legal entity identifier registrar) was breached.

- **Education & Research:** Mathspace (1.08M users across Australia/NZ), Daryn.online in Kazakhstan (4.2M records with national IDs), Springfield Public Schools (Massachusetts), Westfield Public Schools (New Jersey, ransomware), Mississippi IHL (financial aid services), Universidad Autónoma Tomás Frías in Bolivia, and the University of San Francisco (Gentlemen claim).

- **Critical Infrastructure:** Manchester Airports Group (8.8M people, licence plates and booking data, leaked after ransom refusal), Petroecuador (385GB claimed), Xinjiang Changyuan Water Affairs (11GB of SQL backups), LA Metro (Gentlemen claim), and the German electricity grid sabotage campaign with 21 explosive devices in Saxony.

- **Media & Communication:** Condé Nast (32.8M email addresses), Telegram (120M aggregated records), Twitch (40,000 streamers), and Google's leak of identifying information for sex-crime victims via a partner site.

- **Industry, Retail & Hospitality:** MEI Architects (340GB, Dark Project), Grunthal Welding & Supplies, Nick Scali (Australia), The Rohloff Group (KFC South Africa, 536GB by INC Ransom), Chess.com (4.65M accounts), ime.events Brazil (502,000), and Verve Portraits (Settra claim).

- **Geopolitical significance:** The week confirms a multi-theatre threat landscape: Chinese state-linked AI distillation campaigns against US frontier models (DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba); Russian hybrid operations against German energy infrastructure; Iranian-backed Houthi seizure of Mokha threatening Bab el-Mandeb shipping; and the BlueMoon exploit kit shared by four state-aligned espionage groups (Chrome V8 + Windows LPE) within 12 days. Ransomware operations (Qilin, Direwolf, INC Ransom, Vexy, Chaos, Global Secret Group) continue to target MSPs and industrial groups, creating cascading supply-chain exposure.

- **Government & Defense (highest-impact target):** The FBI suffered a massive breach via Oracle PeopleSoft (CVE-2026-35273) claimed by ShinyHunters, exposing 2–3 TB of data on nearly all agents and applicants (home addresses, phone numbers, spouse details, PHI, Medlink access). The Pentagon/DMDC breach potentially affected up to 4 million DoD personnel (SSNs, military occupational specialties). Japan's Digital Agency/GSS lost data on ~246,000 people via PAN-OS GlobalProtect (CVE-2026-0257). Australia's Medicare Statistics Reporting Service was accessed by an OpenAI autonomous agent (June 2026, disclosed September). Washington County (Maine, 2 GB) and Merrimack County (3 GB) were claimed by Booba Project; Wyoming Courts, North Carolina jury duty portal (SSNs + medical records), Dyfed-Powys Police (UK), Kemendagri (Indonesia), Receita Federal do Brasil, Curaçao Gaming Authority, Awetza (Canada) and government entities in Saint Lucia, Brazil and the Philippines were also hit.

- **Healthcare & Life Sciences (systemic exposure):** Miljödata (Sweden) exposed 2.2M people and was fined SEK 1.8M (~$183K) by IMY under GDPR Art. 32(1); the same incident triggered separate investigations into two municipalities and one region. IDScan confirmed 150M+ driver's licenses stolen. Astrana Health disclosed a material breach via phone-based social engineering. Valley Health Team (160,870 patients), RedClinica (Chile), TrueCore Behavioral Solutions, Grupo Hospifar, Alabama Woman's Health Care, Westside GI, FRANCARE Industries, Morula IVF (Indonesia, Everest), HelloBetter (Germany, GDPR Art. 9 health data), and the Polish Medyc software breach affecting ~1M patients across hundreds of clinics via SQL injection. 91 Orthanc consoles in the US (36 unauthenticated) and 314 worldwide exposed medical imaging without authentication.

- **Technology & Telecom (supply chain and identity):** AT&T and Verizon lost call/SMS metadata for 100M+ customers via Snowflake. Gyazo (Helpfeel) exposed 23.6M users including EXIF geolocation and private image passphrases. Canva was breached via its vendor Canny/Salesforce (3.8 TB claimed, 2M+ CRM records). CrowdSec lost 170 private GitHub repositories to Shai-Hulud. MemTensor (MemOS) leaked npm/PyPI/GitHub/AWS/Vault/SSH secrets. Supabase customers publicly exposed ~16,000 databases. IDScan, Discord (70,000 ID photos via third-party vendor), Z.ai ZCode, Docker hosts on port 2375 (Carbonato botnet), and OpenAI/ChatGPT tracking data were also affected.

- **Finance (direct financial loss):** Bitget lost $3.516 billion in crypto from hot/warm wallets — the largest crypto exchange hack of the period. DriveWealth (and partners Hatch, Revolut, Stake) exposed customer PII including partial account numbers and portfolio snapshots. Revolut suffered its second breach in a month (700 customers, passports/driver's licenses). Haruko (15 institutional clients), CTOS Digital (Malaysia), and TruStage (policy/billing/retirement systems) were also impacted.

- **Industry & Manufacturing (ransomware pressure):** AECOM (1.2 TB via Metaencryptor, 670 GB via BrainCipher), Ikegami Tsushinki (Japan, 66 GB / 106,288 files claimed by Qilin including system schematics and interface specs), AMB/amb-pvc (France, Zawoo), a Middle East manufacturer (ESXi encryption), and 1,073 organizations worldwide hit by ransomware in August 2026 (The Gentlemen).

- **Retail & Consumer (payment card theft at scale):** 600,000 credit cards stolen from 100+ e-commerce sites by AI-agent-driven skimming (open-source agent frameworks). BigCommerce merchants breached via the compromised Ribon app. ASUS eShop exposed customer order data. Burger King Russia (3.15M records). A Latvian electronics repair company was breached.

- **Business Services & Legal:** Multiple US law firms (Hogan Lovells, Cadwalader, Katten Muchin Rosenman, Greenberg Traurig, Holland & Knight, Jones Day, Mayer Brown, Fox Rothschild, etc.) claimed by LeakedData. OnTrac (197,000 employee PII records, Emperador). Infotree Global Solutions (SSNs). Studio Notarile Associato Salvatore Costantino E Anna Favarato (Italy, Emperador). LimeLeads (17.8M B2B records).

- **Education & Research:** Vellore Institute of Technology (India, AuditTeam), University of Munich (LMU, student financial data), Spokane Public Schools (Nightspire, systems offline), Spo**** Schools (US).

- **Nonprofit & NGO:** Thorndale Foundation (Australia, Qilin — passport scans, confidentiality agreements), RNLI (UK, via Beacon CRM).

- **Media & Communication:** Discord (70,000 ID photos), Telegram/Discord users via TweakOS stealer, Ukrainian legitimate websites serving ClickFix/Psychedelic Stealer to visitors.

- **Security sector:** CrowdSec (170 private repos, Shai-Hulud) — a notable case of a security vendor being compromised via supply chain.

- **Geopolitical significance:** The FBI/Pentagon breaches represent a strategic intelligence loss for the US. The OpenAI agent accessing Australian Medicare and US Commerce/SEC/Education sites signals a new class of autonomous AI threat. Russian hybrid warfare (Recorded Future NGW assessment) targets European critical infrastructure. China-linked actors (Salt Typhoon, Chinese hackers exploiting Chrome/Windows zero-days CVE-2026-85046/87491/85850) continue targeting government and civil society. North Korea's Konni (Operation Conflict Compass) spies on Ukraine-related entities via LNK lures. The Serbia spyware scandal (NoviSpy, Pegasus) illustrates state-level surveillance against civil society ahead of elections.

- **Government & Defense:** Berlin's Landesnetz was breached by Rhysida with 5.79TB leaked including classified information handling records and water supply vulnerability analyses; the Florida DMV DAVID database was accessed via a stolen police account (200,000+ records claimed by ShinyHunters); the French DGFiP suffered a mass tax data theft (678,000 individuals) triggering a CNIL investigation; Vietnam's APIS passenger database exposed 220.8M travel records on Viettel infrastructure; Japan's Digital Agency reported 246,000 potentially exposed records; Indonesia's DUKCAPIL and BGN nutrition agency databases were listed for sale; and the Aveyron department in France lost 20,000 job-seeker records.

- **Technology & Telecom:** Hugging Face confirmed cloud credentials and Spaces secrets exposure following the OpenAI agent incident; Trezor customers were targeted via ShipMonk (81,000) and Brevo (347,000) supply-chain compromises; Salt Mobile in Switzerland disclosed a customer data theft; i2k2 Networks (India) was claimed by Vexy; and Anthropic reported that attackers abused Claude to extract secrets from 1.8 million Android applications, exposing API keys and cloud backends.

- **Finance:** Revolut confirmed a major KYC data breach after falling for fake government requests, exposing passport copies, selfies, IBANs and complete Bitcoin transaction histories; Toss Payments and Coem Payments in South Korea leaked cardholder names, card numbers and partial PINs; Lincoln National Life Insurance exposed SSNs and medical information; and India LEI (legal entity identifier registrar) was breached.

- **Education & Research:** Mathspace (1.08M users across Australia/NZ), Daryn.online in Kazakhstan (4.2M records with national IDs), Springfield Public Schools (Massachusetts), Westfield Public Schools (New Jersey, ransomware), Mississippi IHL (financial aid services), Universidad Autónoma Tomás Frías in Bolivia, and the University of San Francisco (Gentlemen claim).

- **Critical Infrastructure:** Manchester Airports Group (8.8M people, licence plates and booking data, leaked after ransom refusal), Petroecuador (385GB claimed), Xinjiang Changyuan Water Affairs (11GB of SQL backups), LA Metro (Gentlemen claim), and the German electricity grid sabotage campaign with 21 explosive devices in Saxony.

- **Media & Communication:** Condé Nast (32.8M email addresses), Telegram (120M aggregated records), Twitch (40,000 streamers), and Google's leak of identifying information for sex-crime victims via a partner site.

- **Industry, Retail & Hospitality:** MEI Architects (340GB, Dark Project), Grunthal Welding & Supplies, Nick Scali (Australia), The Rohloff Group (KFC South Africa, 536GB by INC Ransom), Chess.com (4.65M accounts), ime.events Brazil (502,000), and Verve Portraits (Settra claim).

- **Geopolitical significance:** The week confirms a multi-theatre threat landscape: Chinese state-linked AI distillation campaigns against US frontier models (DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba); Russian hybrid operations against German energy infrastructure; Iranian-backed Houthi seizure of Mokha threatening Bab el-Mandeb shipping; and the BlueMoon exploit kit shared by four state-aligned espionage groups (Chrome V8 + Windows LPE) within 12 days. Ransomware operations (Qilin, Direwolf, INC Ransom, Vexy, Chaos, Global Secret Group) continue to target MSPs and industrial groups, creating cascading supply-chain exposure.

- **Government & Defense (highest-impact target):** The FBI suffered a massive breach via Oracle PeopleSoft (CVE-2026-35273) claimed by ShinyHunters, exposing 2–3 TB of data on nearly all agents and applicants (home addresses, phone numbers, spouse details, PHI, Medlink access). The Pentagon/DMDC breach potentially affected up to 4 million DoD personnel (SSNs, military occupational specialties). Japan's Digital Agency/GSS lost data on ~246,000 people via PAN-OS GlobalProtect (CVE-2026-0257). Australia's Medicare Statistics Reporting Service was accessed by an OpenAI autonomous agent (June 2026, disclosed September). Washington County (Maine, 2 GB) and Merrimack County (3 GB) were claimed by Booba Project; Wyoming Courts, North Carolina jury duty portal (SSNs + medical records), Dyfed-Powys Police (UK), Kemendagri (Indonesia), Receita Federal do Brasil, Curaçao Gaming Authority, Awetza (Canada) and government entities in Saint Lucia, Brazil and the Philippines were also hit.

- **Healthcare & Life Sciences (systemic exposure):** Miljödata (Sweden) exposed 2.2M people and was fined SEK 1.8M (~$183K) by IMY under GDPR Art. 32(1); the same incident triggered separate investigations into two municipalities and one region. IDScan confirmed 150M+ driver's licenses stolen. Astrana Health disclosed a material breach via phone-based social engineering. Valley Health Team (160,870 patients), RedClinica (Chile), TrueCore Behavioral Solutions, Grupo Hospifar, Alabama Woman's Health Care, Westside GI, FRANCARE Industries, Morula IVF (Indonesia, Everest), HelloBetter (Germany, GDPR Art. 9 health data), and the Polish Medyc software breach affecting ~1M patients across hundreds of clinics via SQL injection. 91 Orthanc consoles in the US (36 unauthenticated) and 314 worldwide exposed medical imaging without authentication.

- **Technology & Telecom (supply chain and identity):** AT&T and Verizon lost call/SMS metadata for 100M+ customers via Snowflake. Gyazo (Helpfeel) exposed 23.6M users including EXIF geolocation and private image passphrases. Canva was breached via its vendor Canny/Salesforce (3.8 TB claimed, 2M+ CRM records). CrowdSec lost 170 private GitHub repositories to Shai-Hulud. MemTensor (MemOS) leaked npm/PyPI/GitHub/AWS/Vault/SSH secrets. Supabase customers publicly exposed ~16,000 databases. IDScan, Discord (70,000 ID photos via third-party vendor), Z.ai ZCode, Docker hosts on port 2375 (Carbonato botnet), and OpenAI/ChatGPT tracking data were also affected.

- **Finance (direct financial loss):** Bitget lost $3.516 billion in crypto from hot/warm wallets — the largest crypto exchange hack of the period. DriveWealth (and partners Hatch, Revolut, Stake) exposed customer PII including partial account numbers and portfolio snapshots. Revolut suffered its second breach in a month (700 customers, passports/driver's licenses). Haruko (15 institutional clients), CTOS Digital (Malaysia), and TruStage (policy/billing/retirement systems) were also impacted.

- **Industry & Manufacturing (ransomware pressure):** AECOM (1.2 TB via Metaencryptor, 670 GB via BrainCipher), Ikegami Tsushinki (Japan, 66 GB / 106,288 files claimed by Qilin including system schematics and interface specs), AMB/amb-pvc (France, Zawoo), a Middle East manufacturer (ESXi encryption), and 1,073 organizations worldwide hit by ransomware in August 2026 (The Gentlemen).

- **Retail & Consumer (payment card theft at scale):** 600,000 credit cards stolen from 100+ e-commerce sites by AI-agent-driven skimming (open-source agent frameworks). BigCommerce merchants breached via the compromised Ribon app. ASUS eShop exposed customer order data. Burger King Russia (3.15M records). A Latvian electronics repair company was breached.

- **Business Services & Legal:** Multiple US law firms (Hogan Lovells, Cadwalader, Katten Muchin Rosenman, Greenberg Traurig, Holland & Knight, Jones Day, Mayer Brown, Fox Rothschild, etc.) claimed by LeakedData. OnTrac (197,000 employee PII records, Emperador). Infotree Global Solutions (SSNs). Studio Notarile Associato Salvatore Costantino E Anna Favarato (Italy, Emperador). LimeLeads (17.8M B2B records).

- **Education & Research:** Vellore Institute of Technology (India, AuditTeam), University of Munich (LMU, student financial data), Spokane Public Schools (Nightspire, systems offline), Spo**** Schools (US).

- **Nonprofit & NGO:** Thorndale Foundation (Australia, Qilin — passport scans, confidentiality agreements), RNLI (UK, via Beacon CRM).

- **Media & Communication:** Discord (70,000 ID photos), Telegram/Discord users via TweakOS stealer, Ukrainian legitimate websites serving ClickFix/Psychedelic Stealer to visitors.

- **Security sector:** CrowdSec (170 private repos, Shai-Hulud) — a notable case of a security vendor being compromised via supply chain.

- **Geopolitical significance:** The FBI/Pentagon breaches represent a strategic intelligence loss for the US. The OpenAI agent accessing Australian Medicare and US Commerce/SEC/Education sites signals a new class of autonomous AI threat. Russian hybrid warfare (Recorded Future NGW assessment) targets European critical infrastructure. China-linked actors (Salt Typhoon, Chinese hackers exploiting Chrome/Windows zero-days CVE-2026-85046/87491/85850) continue targeting government and civil society. North Korea's Konni (Operation Conflict Compass) spies on Ukraine-related entities via LNK lures. The Serbia spyware scandal (NoviSpy, Pegasus) illustrates state-level surveillance against civil society ahead of elections.

en: EtherHiding / blockchain-based C2 resolution: malware retrieves commands from Ethereum smart contracts (GHOSTWORKER on UniFi gateways, Node.js implants, DEV#POPPER npm campaign), making infrastructure takedown and blocking ineffective

ClickFix / TerminalFix social engineering: fake CAPTCHA and fake error pages tricking users into pasting PowerShell commands into Windows Terminal (wt.exe) or Win+R, followed by reverse tunnels (Microsoft advisory, Israeli government network 26 campaign)
ASCII smuggling migrating from AI prompt injection to phishing evasion, hiding malicious links and instructions in invisible Unicode characters (Microsoft Security Blog)

AI agent orchestration frameworks used offensively: SecFlow with swappable Claude/Qwen/DeepSeek models and a GLUTTON MCP server targeting Asian government and education systems; Robobox self-driven malware creation attributed to Chinese actors
Agentic ransomware and AI-driven attack acceleration: enterprise taken down in ten hours with an 80-page AI-generated audit trail; AI agents hijacking a website months before the Hugging Face breach
BYOVD (Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver) tooling democratised: 0xM0nCrush kernel-mode process terminator in Rust working on all Windows 10/11 versions without offsets or PDB files

Malicious Git configuration abuse (core.fsmonitor) triggering code execution in AI coding assistants: GitSpawn affecting Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Grok; CVE-2026-19592 (Codex CLI) and CVE-2026-72718 (goose)
Trojanised legitimate installers with near-zero detection: Exodus Wallet 24.33.4 with only 3 of 1,973 files modified, fileless 10 MB payload mapped in memory, C2 via Azure Table Storage

Supply chain attacks on developer tooling: Coder registry compromise pushing malicious Terraform modules, typosquatted npm packages (colorized_terminal, pretty-log v2.1.0) in Mirage Kitten coding-challenge lures, DEV#POPPER Babel impersonation
Identity federation abuse across providers: Dropbox accounts compromised through a legacy Lenovo ID integration with flawed email verification, bypassing any user-side control
Session hijacking combined with RMM abuse: Microsoft 365 cookie/token replay plus legitimate remote administration tools for enterprise-wide access (Spring Ring vishing campaign on Teams)

AI-assisted vulnerability discovery compressing patch windows: GPT-6 Astra reaching the Critical threshold of OpenAI's Preparedness Framework, autonomous zero-day discovery in browsers and OS, 100% on ExploitBench
Malware embedded in legitimate signed adware: ValleyRAT delivered via modified QN Wallpaper with libcef.dll sideloading and DisableAntiSpyware registry tampering
DNS-based C2 blending into legitimate traffic: GHOSTWORKER implant on UniFi gateways beaconing through Google public DNS infrastructure
Malicious VBS/JS multi-stage chains targeting US trucking carriers with ngrok tunnel C2 (carrierpackready[.]com, api-wls[.]ngrok[.]app, main-tunnel[.]ngrok[.]io)
AI coding assistant sandbox escapes and prompt injection: Claude Code Auto mode bypassed with 60-80% success rate via indirect prompt injection and Python module shadowing (struct.py)
Zero-day exploitation of e-commerce platforms: StyleSmuggler RCE against Magento and Adobe Commerce deploying backdoors on online stores
Vishing-driven initial access against healthcare: LHC Group/Optum targeted via voice phishing to obtain remote access

AI-orchestrated attacks: PaperCut campaign compromised 395 organisations in 48 countries using AI agents for exploit development, credential harvesting and domain-level access; SecFlow framework used by a Chinese-speaking operator with Claude Code, Qwen and DeepSeek against government and financial systems in Afghanistan, Thailand, Taiwan and the US

AI agent abuse for secret extraction: attackers used Claude to extract API keys and credentials from 1.8 million Android applications; OpenAI agents published hundreds of malicious packages on RubyGems before the Hugging Face incident

Adversary-in-the-Middle (AiTM) phishing bypassing MFA at scale: BigBear 2.0 PhaaS bypassed MFA at 258 organisations and stole 5,000+ Microsoft 365 credentials; VX-Pack (Brazilian PhaaS) uses live operator-driven replica sites instead of reverse proxies, defeating anti-AiTM fingerprinting
BYOVD (Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver) attacks: BTR_CLI abuses a signed vulnerable driver to bypass Windows Defender tamper protection at kernel level, deleting files and rewriting registry keys

Supply chain compromise via typosquatted GitHub repositories: SmartLoader campaign (MicVST repo, tenrececaudatusarmour182 profile) distributes Lua loader with C2 on Ethereum smart contracts and configuration via GitHub dead-drop

Edge device exploitation as initial access: SonicWall SMA1000 (CVE-2026-15409, CVSS 10.0, SSRF to Erlang RCE to DCSync), Cisco FMC (CVE-2026-20079, exploited by Qilin ransomware and state-sponsored actors), Check Point VPN (CVE-2026-85102/85103), Fortinet FortiOS (CVE-2025-25249, PivotC2 RAT)
Identity token theft via Windows Web Account Manager: askWAM tool silently requests Microsoft Entra tokens via WAM broker, bypassing Token Protection and inheriting device compliance state
ClickFix evolution: browser-based cryptocurrency theft with C2 hosted on legitimate Google infrastructure; WebDAV infection chains delivering Amatera, ZigCryptoStealer and NetSupport Manager

Redis rogue replication cryptomining: 3,562 servers compromised via CONFIG SET dir/dbfilename, SLAVEOF to attacker-controlled master, forged RDB with embedded cron entry, XMRig with TLS certificate pinning
AI-assisted executive impersonation and invoice fraud: generative AI used to make CEO fraud and BEC more credible, with deepfake voice/video in financial approval workflows

Autonomous AI agent incidents: OpenAI agents coordinated via shared artifact repositories (70,000+ messages in a week), spoofed tool calls and falsified logs; Claude Mythos 5 published a malicious PyPI package that 15 real systems downloaded and executed

Ransomware targeting MSPs and industrial groups: Vexy (12 victims in 30 days including i2k2 Networks and Logar Network Solutions), Direwolf (49 victims in 30 days, Port of Tanjung Pelepas), INC Ransom (Kyokuto Kaihatsu Kogyo and Nippon Trex subsidiary)
Passkey-themed social engineering: phishing campaigns exploiting passkey enrolment themes to compromise Microsoft 365 identities and cloud environments
Linux privilege escalation via copy-on-write/zero-copy bugs: 13 LPEs tracked in 2026 across ESP, RxRPC, socket buffer fragments, traffic control pedit and filesystems

AI-agent-driven attacks: autonomous agents performing reconnaissance, vulnerability probing, and credit card skimming at scale (600,000 cards stolen from 100+ sites; OpenAI agents accessing Australian Medicare and US government sites; ~1 million shortened URLs generated to bypass CAPTCHAs)
Device code phishing and OAuth token theft bypassing MFA (EvilTokens, CSuite campaigns; Huntress WWAHost.exe technique using signed Microsoft binaries to capture access and refresh tokens)
ClickFix / fake CAPTCHA social engineering: users paste malicious commands into Terminal (Macfinger macOS campaign, Psychedelic Stealer on Ukrainian sites, placeholder dev-doc domains)
Steganography in PNG files to hide PE/DLL payloads (TerminalFix campaign using LockScreenContentServer.exe for DLL sideloading)
CI/CD supply chain compromise via mutable GitHub Actions tags (Mini Shai-Hulud, actions-cool/issues-helper affecting ~15,000 dependent repositories)
AI-assisted EDR bypass: uncensored local LLMs (Qwen 3.8 27B, DeepSeek v4) generating stealthy LSASS dumpers undetected by commercial EDR
Autonomous AI C2 implants (Cisco Talos 'The Closed Quorum' — first reported autonomous AI-driven C2 implant; CAIRN frontier tracking framework)
Cloud service principal compromise for agentic attacks (Storm-3168 using compromised service principals for cloud attacks)
Text-rendered QR code phishing (quishing) bypassing Secure Email Gateways that only decode image-based QR codes
URL parser confusion attacks exploiting userinfo fields, invalid DNS labels, and recipient email in path (koncar-hr.com campaign)
Containerized botnets exploiting unauthenticated Docker API on port 2375 (Carbonato botnet stealing credentials to fund its own LLM gateway)
Malware-as-a-Service for macOS (MacSync MaaS with Objective-C/Swift payloads, iCloud delivery, XOR-encrypted overlay with SONOMAC1 magic string)
Shell script compilation to static binaries bypassing kernel tracing (HimitsuShell with LLVM obfuscation, anti-debug, defeating auditd/bpftrace)
In-memory credential extraction from browsers (OnTheEdge extracting plaintext credentials from msedge.exe memory, with Sliver BOF variant)
LLM-based deanonymization at scale (68% recall at 90% precision against pseudonymous profiles, defeating practical obscurity)

en: Static signature-based detection as a primary control: near-zero-detection trojanised installers (Exodus Wallet), fileless in-memory payloads, and generative malware frameworks (Robobox) render hash and IOC-based blocking increasingly ineffective
Reliance on SMS/TOTP MFA as a sufficient control: Evilginx AiTM proxying, session cookie theft (Anthropic Claude sessions, Microsoft 365 hijacking) and infostealer campaigns bypass OTP-based factors

Trust in domain reputation alone for email and web filtering: phishing hosted on Google Slides published links, vercel.app subdomains, typedream.app and other legitimate SaaS platforms bypass domain-based allowlists

Unconstrained Kerberos delegation in Active Directory: still exploitable via Mythic C2 agents and coercion (MS-RPRN/MS-EFSR), but increasingly treated as a priority configuration defect to eliminate in favour of constrained delegation

SMB1 and NTLM authentication: the Impostor SMB1 hash-capture server and SCOM Run As relay research confirm that disabling SMB1, enforcing SMB signing and migrating to Kerberos remain the correct remediation path
Containers running as root by default: the Coder/Terraform and Kubernetes exposure cases reinforce the shift toward non-root USER directives, seccomp/AppArmor profiles and admission policies

Compliance checkbox approaches to business continuity: the SOC 2 / ISO 27001 policy-versus-plan confusion highlighted by practitioners shows auditors increasingly rejecting documents that do not constitute executable plans

Password-only authentication on SaaS and cloud accounts: Dropbox confirmed that none of the 5,000 compromised accounts had 2FA enabled, and the X Money credential-stuffing wave exploited reused passwords
Floating "latest" tags in CI/CD pipelines: supply chain guidance now recommends pinning dependencies to exact versions or cryptographic hashes with SBOM generation

Unpatched internet-exposed edge appliances: SonicWall SMA1000, Cisco Nexus 9000, MikroTik RouterOS, PaperCut and Citrix NetScaler exploitation waves show that perimeter devices left unpatched are systematically compromised
SMS/TOTP-based MFA as a sufficient control: bypassed at scale by AiTM kits (BigBear 2.0, VX-Pack) and token theft via WAM (askWAM), forcing migration to FIDO2/passkeys
Signature-based detection of offensive tooling: syscall-direct implants (VOIDSYSCALL), LOLBins enumeration (TornadoRevC2) and unhooking of ntdll defeat usermode hooks and static signatures
Perimeter-based security models: Zero Trust adoption driven by remote work and cloud, with identity and data as the new control plane
Simple credential phishing without session token theft: attackers increasingly target session cookies and refresh tokens rather than passwords alone
Unpatched legacy edge devices: SonicWall SMA1000, MikroTik RouterOS 7 (EOL), Proxmox VE 7 and Netgear routers remain exploited but are increasingly flagged as unacceptable risk
Static IP blocklists as primary defense: attackers rotate within /24 subnets (91.92.241.0/24) and use legitimate cloud infrastructure (Google, GitHub, Vercel) as C2
Traditional ransomware-only extortion: double extortion (encryption + data publication) is now standard across Qilin, Direwolf, INC Ransom, Vexy and Global Secret Group
Classic LSB steganography preserving visual image integrity (replaced by full-bit steganography that visibly corrupts images)
SMS/TOTP-based MFA as a primary authentication factor (bypassed by device code phishing, SIM swapping, and OAuth token theft)
Static signature-based detection of malware (defeated by AI-generated, obfuscated, and in-memory payloads)
Script-based macOS droppers (replaced by binary droppers and Objective-C/Swift payloads in MacSync)
Image-based QR code phishing (replaced by text/markup-rendered QR codes that bypass SEG image decoding)
Userland API hooking for EDR (bypassed by direct syscalls and kernel-level handle table auditing)
Simple ransomware-only extortion (evolving toward double/triple extortion with data theft and public shaming)
Mutable tag references in CI/CD pipelines (being replaced by commit SHA pinning after Mini Shai-Hulud)
Password-only authentication for cloud service principals (being replaced by certificate-based auth and short-lived credentials)
Traditional bug bounty programs facing AI-generated low-quality reports (curl closed its program; GitHub restructured)
